parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence or border practice is documented, and the same-sex executions are dated (2011, 2014), defector-based and uncorroborated, so they do not establish current frequency. However, this is a thin-data total-control state: the dossier itself says no reliable information exists, LGBT life has no space, official hostility and denial of existence are documented, organisations cannot register, no anti-discrimination recourse exists, and two undefined offences leave enforcement to discretion. Extrapolating from those structural signals, an outed visitor faces political/moral treatment at official discretion, with the detention-camp execution account indicating possible severity-4/5 outcomes and no remedy. Absence of current trans-specific evidence is not evidence of safety.
